facts.fact: The report states NAM-CSIRT's operationalisation is mandated by the National Cybersecurity Strategy and Awareness Raising Plan (2022-2027).
facts.system: National Cybersecurity Strategy and Awareness Raising Plan (2022-2027)

facts.fact: The report states the national CSIRT was officially launched by the Minister of ICT on 14 April 2025 and completed Phase 3 of its three-year plan, marking full operationalisation.
NAM-CSIRT states 1,701,883 cyber-attack events and 2,231,970 reported vulnerabilities for January to December 2025.
